newsitem.title: UK: UK budget speech to be delayed.
newsitem.headline: UK budget speech to be delayed.

text.p: Chancellor Gordon Brown's budget speech will be delayed by up to half an hour from the planned 1430 GMT start time, the Treasury said.
A spokesman said the delay would be caused by a parliamentary question from a Conservative member about an alleged leak of information about private medical insurance.
The spokesman said Leader of the House of Commons Ann Taylor would make a short statement in response to the private notice question.
Another official estimated that the delay would be 20 to 30 minutes.
Peter Lilley, Treasury spokesman for the opposition Conservatives, earlier accused a government minister who leaked a budget secret of treating parliament with arrogance.
Lilley said the confirmation of a report that the government would end tax relief on private medical care for elderly people could affect markets unfairly.
A senior government minister was early quoted by British media as having said the report was correct.
